fieldValues.title: G6 Facilitated practice
fieldValues.summary: A shared-screen Protocol guides people through canonical decision state, can resume after interruption, and ends in whole-record review and human ratification.
fieldValues.body:
## Group Need

We want to make a decision together in the room or online, one clear step at a time.

## Semantic Adds

- Protocol Run
- attention state
- stage approval

## Blueprint Adds

- shared-screen facilitation mode
- whole-record ratification review

## Does Not Introduce

- transcript capture or TSS emission
- AI-generated wording
- a facilitation-only semantic store

## Activation Trigger

A group wants help holding an actual shared decision process, not merely editing a record.
